name: Leonie de Carcelos
source: Leonie is the daughter of the insanely wealthy de Carcelos oligarch family, who own billions in the island nation of Cosagoria. Leonie despises her family for using their wealth to bring untold suffering upon the Cosagorian people, and seeks to pay for her family's sins.
